'''2009 2K Event''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 28–29 March 2009, in the [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format (Decipher cards only). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2009 2K Event Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2009 2K Event Day 2.pdf]]). The forum calls it the 2009 2K Event (Premiere to Death Star II); [[Hayes Hunter]] won and [[Justin Desai]] was runner-up.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
* '''Dates:''' 28–29 March 2009
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
